offering_description.value: Provides leadership, productivity, sales and execution training to employers and government agencies. It also helps schools teach leadership and life skills to students and staff. It delivers these programs through digital learning platforms, instructor-led workshops and coaching.

primary_products.value: digital workplace training courses; school leadership curricula; training workbooks and facilitator materials

primary_services.value: instructor-led training; executive and team coaching; organizational performance consulting; school implementation support

customer_segment.value: B2B: Employers, private schools and higher education institutions; B2G: Government agencies, public schools and school districts

end_markets.value: corporate learning and development; K–12 education; higher education; public administration

revenue_model.value: subscription: Annual access to workplace learning content and school leadership programs; service fees: Facilitated workshops, coaching and implementation support; licensing or royalties: Rights for international partners to deliver training programs; product sales: Printed workbooks and other training materials
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; licensing or royalties; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Develops leadership curricula and delivers training and coaching to employers, agencies and schools; software / platform: Packages proprietary courses and tools for employers and educators to deliver online learning

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other markets served through local licensees

specialization.value: related lines: Workplace leadership and performance training, sales training and school leadership programs

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Client sales teams serving employers, agencies and school systems; online: Company-operated learning platforms for subscribers; partners / resellers: International licensees that sell and deliver training in their markets

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Training and curriculum delivery subject to general privacy, accessibility and intellectual property rules
